comment: Single source of truth for which sources run, in what order, with what timeouts. The 'method' field reflects the ACTUAL implementation in src/sources/<name>.js, not the idealised plan. Add/remove entries here without code edits to orchestrate.js.

methodLegend.raw_https: Built-in Node fetch() or node:https against server-rendered HTML. No MCP. Used when the site returns full data without JS rendering.
methodLegend.raw_http_batches: Raw node:http for listing + raw node:http in 10-batch for detail pages. No MCP. Used when detail pages have JSON-LD that needs to be fetched in parallel.
methodLegend.playwright_fallback: Imports chromium from 'playwright' directly. Real Chromium browser. Used when the site blocks raw HTTP (anti-bot). NOT via MCP browser tool.
methodLegend.mcp_browser: MCP browser MCP tool (browser_navigate, browser_click, etc.). Used when the site is an SPA that needs JS rendering. Only fires when invoked from a cron agent turn; CLI invocation falls back to raw HTTP (see source code).

sources.name: jobs.ch
sources.notes: Server-rendered HTML, full data inline. Detail pages fetched via raw https in 10-batch. JSON-LD on detail for German detection.

sources.name: itjobs.ch
sources.notes: Server-rendered HTML. Card text >=200 chars usually; skip enrichment. German abbreviations Tg/Std on dates.

sources.name: jobwinner.ch
sources.notes: SPA — MCP browser (browser_navigate / browser_type / browser_wait_for / browser_extract) is the primary path. Raw HTTP fallback returns the SSR shell only (~10 jobs vs full ~50+). The BROWSER_RECIPE constant in the source module is invoked when ctx.browser is provided (cron agent turn). CLI runs use raw HTTP fallback.
sources.dateBadgeTodo: Hard-coded to today in v1; preserved here verbatim — fix tracked separately.

sources.name: linkedin
sources.notes: Playwright (chromium imported directly, NOT via MCP). Anti-bot wall; no MCP path works. 6 keywords serial — LinkedIn nav never settles so parallelism doesn't help.

sources.name: jobscout24.ch
sources.notes: Listing via raw HTTP (find /de/job/<uuid>/ hrefs); detail pages via raw HTTP in 10-batch. JSON-LD on detail for German detection.

sources.name: ictcareer.ch
sources.notes: Server-rendered HTML for listing. Detail pages blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile under headless — listing-only. descSnippet is card text only.

sources.name: jobup.ch
sources.notes: Server-rendered HTML, inline JobPosting JSON-LD. 5 pages × 20 postings. descSnippet is teaser only — German detection limited.
